steps.name: Level-Headed Patient
steps.text: We don't want any trouble, sir.

steps.name: Level-Headed Patient
steps.text: We're just here at this office for a bit while reconstruction work is going on at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Level-Headed Patient
steps.text: The office has an agreement with the city council. We'll live on an undeveloped plate, and we won't have any contact with the people in the county.

steps.name: Level-Headed Patient
steps.text: We won't trouble you at all.

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: Won't trouble us? Then what about this bloke? He showed up at MY door!

steps.name: Agitated Patient
steps.text: I'm from Ashford! I left after selling my home to pay medical bills.

steps.name: Agitated Patient
steps.text: I just wanted to see what became of my old house!

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: So it was you!

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: I spent big money on this house, only to learn that the previous owner was some bloody Infected!

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: Nothing has gone right since then, and I can't find a buyer for the place! This is all your fault!

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: You said you're from Ashford? I've got news for you, friend: there was no place for you here the moment you got Oripathy!

steps.name: Agitated Patient
steps.text: Why you—

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: How dare you fight back! I swear you'll pay for this!

steps.name: County Police
steps.text: What's all the commotion?

steps.name: Level-Headed Patient
steps.text: Sir, we—

steps.name: County Police
steps.text: You're those new Infected, aren't you? Why are you here in town and not on the plate that's been assigned to you?

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: These dirty Infected attacked me, sir!

steps.name: Agitated Patient
steps.text: I... I just...

steps.name: County Police
steps.text: Knew nothing good could come of letting Infected in. You're under arrest!

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: That's right! Run them out of town! Who knows if they're really just here for a while, or if they aren't planning something dirty.

steps.name: Level-Headed Patient
steps.text: Sir, we—

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Hold it.

steps.name: Agitated Patient
steps.text: Mr. Adnachiel—

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I came as soon as I heard. Are you okay?

steps.name: Level-Headed Patient
steps.text: We're fine. But—

steps.name: County Police
steps.text: And who might you be?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Adnachiel, Rhodes Island Reserve Op Team A4. I was in charge of escorting these patients.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I take responsibility for their actions.

steps.name: County Police
steps.text: And how exactly do you propose to take this responsibility? Who'd make it up to us if you exploded and killed us?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Rhodes Island is doing everything in our power to prevent that from happening.

steps.name: County Police
steps.text: Hmph. 'Everything in your power'. Like that counts for anything. Don't think you can throw your weight around just because some bigwig let you in.

steps.name: County Police
steps.text: I can run all of you out of town for this, you hear me?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: ...*sigh*.

steps.name: County Police
steps.text: Now, you're coming with me, and don't you dare make a wrong move!

steps.name: County Police
steps.text: The director of the Rhodes Island branch office shouldn't be here right now, Adamant.

steps.name: County Police
steps.text: And I shouldn't open this door for you.

steps.name: County Police
steps.text: But I'll let you see him because Rhodes Island treated my brother.

steps.name: Adamant
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Are Rodrey and Palmera doing alright? I don't suppose the people here will be too hard on them if they've got the 'main culprit' locked up like this.

steps.name: Adamant
steps.text: They're doing fine.

steps.name: Adamant
steps.text: Wish I could say the same about the situation, though.

steps.name: Adamant
steps.text: We've got a few witnesses who can testify that it was that young man who incited the conflict, but that's not going to matter to the people who're simply looking for an excuse.

steps.name: Adamant
steps.text: A lot of people were already unhappy about the government's decision to allow Oripathy patients to stay on the undeveloped plate.

steps.name: Adamant
steps.text: And now, they've found their excuse. I got word that some of the nobles are already on their way to the city council as we speak, to discuss whether to accept these patients.

steps.name: Adamant
steps.text: ...*sigh*.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: The placement plans while construction at Rhodes Island is going on were intended to allow patients to be closer to home.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Rodrey was born and raised here. He went through so much before he found his place at Rhodes Island. Who could blame him for wanting to see his old home again?

steps.name: Adamant
steps.text: No one's blaming him, not in this room anyway.

steps.name: Adamant
steps.text: But it took tremendous effort and all the connections the branch could muster in order to persuade the powers to allow the patients to settle on the undeveloped plate.

steps.name: Adamant
steps.text: We'll have a problem on our hands if these patients have to leave.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I know. Amongst the three counties in this region where we have an office, Ashford is already the friendliest towards the Infected.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: We wouldn't have to gather all the patients here if the other two counties didn't turn us down.

steps.name: Adamant
steps.text: Exactly. If they're deported, they'll have to take the long way round to branches in other regions, which is too much of a burden for the patients...

steps.name: County Police
steps.text: It's time for you to go, Adamant.

steps.name: Adamant
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Adamant
steps.text: I'm in charge here, and this is my responsibility.

steps.name: Adamant
steps.text: I'll find a way to get you out, and deal with the aftermath. There are a few influential nobles in the city council whom we might be able to sway.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Say, Adamant, remember that side hustle you wrote to me about last year?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: How is it going?

steps.name: Adamant
steps.text: Not too bad, I suppose.

steps.name: Adamant
steps.text: But is this really the time to talk about that?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: ...I have an idea. I'll need you to find my teammates.

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: You know those Infected on the undeveloped plate?

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: Go gather up the boys, and we'll teach them a lesson.

steps.name: Curious Youth
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: Word has gotten out about what happened in the morning. Everybody in the county has their eyes on them now.

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: All we need to do is add fuel to the fire.

steps.name: Curious Youth
steps.text: Do we really need to go that far?

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: They're Infected, for Terra's sake! Do YOU want a bunch of ticking time bombs sleeping next door?

steps.name: Curious Youth
steps.text: Well... guess not...

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: Don't you understand? Once we've done this, we'll be the heroes of the county, no matter how things turn out in the end.

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: Heroes who drove the Infected out!

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: Think of the money we can make! No one will look down on us anymore! You want to live a better life, don't you?

steps.name: Curious Youth
steps.text: ...Yeah.

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: Then go get the boys!

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: And grab some weapons!

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: Today's the day that we become heroes of Ashford!

steps.name: Curious Youth
steps.text: I'm with you!

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: Finally, here's my big chance...

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: It's your unlucky day, Infected. You're gonna make me a lot of money.

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: Listen, I don't have the money right now, but I'll have it soon—

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: Am I speaking to Mr. Philips?

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: Uh, guess you are... what do you want from me?

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: I'm a spice merchant based in Londinium, and my business has taken me to Ashford lately.

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: I would like to purchase my own residence here, and I learned that your house is for sale. If you're still selling, I'm willing to offer a very competitive price.

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: ...R—Really?

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: But I'm—

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: I'm afraid I have little time to waste, and I shall have to look elsewhere should you be unable to give me an answer on the spot.

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: Uh... I—I see, alright, just tell me the place and I'll come find you.

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: Please come to the cafe at Council Square.

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: A—Alright, I'll be right there.

steps.name: Hot-Blooded Youth
steps.text: Today is my lucky day!

steps.name: Curious Youth
steps.text: I got the boys, Philips—hey, where did he go?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: That young man...

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: He was hot-headed, actively inciting conflict with the patients. From his outfit, I gather he was not of means.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: He could be the spark that sets off the fire.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: At the same time, he's also the easiest potential threat to neutralize.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: My speculation is that he's not actually actively hostile to Oripathy patients, but rather trying to stir up conflict and profit from it.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Melantha comes from a family of merchants. She will have no trouble playing the part of a wealthy businesswoman who's interested in buying the house.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Distract him from the Infected, and he won't be stirring up anything for a while.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: That's one potential threat neutralized.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: But this is just the start.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: What comes next is the tough part.

steps.name: Agitated Citizen
steps.text: I say run them all out of town, along with this Rhodes Island of theirs!

steps.name: Agitated Citizen
steps.text: I was against the Rhodes Island office from the beginning! We should do as all the other counties do, and kick out anyone who has Oripathy!

steps.name: Hesitant Citizen
steps.text: What if you're the one who gets Oripathy?

steps.name: Agitated Citizen
steps.text: Me, Oripathy? Never! I eat well, sleep well, and exercise every day!

steps.name: Agitated Citizen
steps.text: If you ask me, what happened today was just a matter of time.

steps.name: Agitated Citizen
steps.text: I tell you, my uncle's on his way to the city council right now to convince the other nobles to run these Infected out of town.

steps.name: Hesitant Citizen
steps.text: ...I know a few Rhodes Island doctors. They're good people.

steps.name: Agitated Citizen
steps.text: So what? Can they cure Oripathy?

steps.name: Hesitant Citizen
steps.text: ...I suppose you're right.

steps.name: Agitated Citizen
steps.text: See? We don't need the Infected here, and we don't need doctors treating those Infected.

steps.name: Mild-Mannered Youth
steps.text: Not necessarily.

steps.name: Agitated Citizen
steps.text: What, are you speaking up for the Infected?

steps.name: Mild-Mannered Youth
steps.text: No, I'm not speaking up for them.

steps.name: Mild-Mannered Youth
steps.text: I just want to offer another perspective.

steps.name: Hesitant Citizen
steps.text: What do you mean?
Under the faint lamplight, the young man clutches his collar, hiding the Originium crystals on his body.

steps.name: Mild-Mannered Youth
steps.text: The city council has been talking about developing those unused plates for years, but work has yet to begin for various reasons.

steps.name: Mild-Mannered Youth
steps.text: At the end of the day, it all comes down to two things: Money and manpower.

steps.name: Mild-Mannered Youth
steps.text: As far as money goes, I'm sure the nobles have plenty.

steps.name: Mild-Mannered Youth
steps.text: The problem has always been manpower.

steps.name: Hesitant Citizen
steps.text: That's true... my uncle's an engineer, and he said no contractor wants to take that job because it's all pain and no gain. It's been a headache for the city council for a while.

steps.name: Mild-Mannered Youth
steps.text: If we kick out the Infected because we don't need them. In the same way, do we throw out an unused plate because we don't need it?

steps.name: Agitated Citizen
steps.text: To hell you will! It was paid by MY taxes!

steps.name: Hesitant Citizen
steps.text: You got a better idea?

steps.name: Mild-Mannered Youth
steps.text: Why don't we shut the Infected and the pharmaceutical company who treats them on the undeveloped plate, and let them develop it for us?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: It's futile trying to persuade the public that our patients are harmless and under Rhodes Island control.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: The public naturally tends to reject Oripathy once it enters the consciousness.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: The simplest and most effective solution is to distract them with something even bigger.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Steward is one of the most persuasive people I've met. He should be able to influence public opinion to a certain extent.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: At the very least, we can give the public a third option—

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: 'If we're going to deal with the Infected anyway, we might as well make them work for us.'

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: It's not a nice thing to think about.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: But it's the best I can come up with under present circumstances.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: While we might be able to influence public opinion to an extent, it ultimately just serves to prevent public opinion from forcing the nobles' hand.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: The last and most important part is the nobles' decision.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I'm counting on you, Cardigan.
A few days later...

steps.name: Laid-Back Baron
steps.text: We've been discussing this for days, Lord Viscount. It's time we came to a decision.

steps.name: Laid-Back Baron
steps.text: Something as trivial as whether to kick a bunch of Infected out has already caused me to miss three performances that I was looking forward to.

steps.name: Scathing Baron
steps.text: YOU were the one who proposed to have a Rhodes Island office in the county, and YOU were the one who persuaded the Lord Viscount to let those patients in.

steps.name: Scathing Baron
steps.text: Are you trying to pretend all that didn't happen?

steps.name: Laid-Back Baron
steps.text: I always have the best interests of the county at heart.

steps.name: Laid-Back Baron
steps.text: Rhodes Island is a pharmaceutical company with a bright future. Working with them can only be a positive for the county. Indeed, medical care in the county has improved considerably in the past two years.

steps.name: Laid-Back Baron
steps.text: As for the patients, it's not like the undeveloped plate was doing anything useful just being left to collect dust. Much better to do Rhodes Island a favor and collect on it later.

steps.name: Laid-Back Baron
steps.text: Besides, remind me who's been talking about developing the new plate and doing exactly nothing about it?

steps.name: Laid-Back Baron
steps.text: I would hardly have proposed to use it to house the patients if it was doing anything useful.

steps.name: Scathing Baron
steps.text: H—How DARE you! I bet you're behind those people stirring up the masses and talking about using the patients to develop the new plate!

steps.name: Laid-Back Baron
steps.text: Would you believe me if I said I wasn't?

steps.name: Scathing Baron
steps.text: Hmph. Whatever you're planning, I can tell you—

steps.name: Scathing Baron
steps.text: Those patients couldn't possibly have the capability to develop the new plate.

steps.name: Laid-Back Baron
steps.text: You and I can say whatever we want. At the end of the day, it's the Lord Viscount's word that counts.

steps.name: Reserved Viscount
steps.text: Rufus. I listened to you about Rhodes Island, and they have indeed generated considerable economic value for the county.

steps.name: Reserved Viscount
steps.text: I hear that some of the people are now in favor of allowing them to stay on the new plate... if they help us develop the new plate.

steps.name: Reserved Viscount
steps.text: But this notion is not realistic. What can a rabble of patients possibly achieve?

steps.name: Laid-Back Baron
steps.text: Speaking... yes, very well.

steps.name: Laid-Back Baron
steps.text: Tell them to come in.

steps.name: Laid-Back Baron
steps.text: You're absolutely correct, Your Ladyship.

steps.name: Laid-Back Baron
steps.text: But what if it's not just the patients helping to develop the plate?

steps.name: Adamant
steps.text: Greetings, Lord Viscount.

steps.name: Reserved Viscount
steps.text: Adamant? It's a little late to come to see me now.

steps.name: Adamant
steps.text: Perhaps the people with me can change your mind.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Phew, made it in time.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Can you believe how little time Adnachiel gave me to get help from the two nearest branches?

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: I'm completely spent.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: You're the fastest amongst us, after all.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: I take it the other branches approved of Adnachiel's plan, from the assistance they provided.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: What can I say? They all trust our great prophet.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: If you ask me, they just haven't found out about the evil underneath that harmless exterior.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: What has he done, other than tricking you into paying his bill from time to time?

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: And you think that's not evil enough? Anyway, I'm making him pay for MY meals for a whole week this time!

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: And you bet I'll pick the most expensive stuff!

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Well, looks like his wallet's going to take a hit.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: That's right! I'll teach him that ordering me about comes at a price!

steps.name: Adamant
steps.text: Ahem—

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Oh, sorry.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Your Ladyship, my name is Cardigan, from Rhodes Island Reserve Op Team A4.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: I'm joined by the directors of the Rhodes Island offices in counties Dovel and Hafilax.

steps.name: Reserved Viscount
steps.text: The adjacent counties—

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Rhodes Island has long been aware of County Ashford's plans to build a hospital on the new plate, but the local branch didn't have the resources to support a project of that scale.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: We've taken this opportunity to discuss with the directors of the other offices in the area.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: They have agreed to supply resources and manpower to assist with the building of a new hospital in Ashford.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Now, we have both manpower and resources, if you are interested.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Only Cardigan is fast enough to request support from the offices located in the two adjacent counties.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: The viscount will not like it. She can undoubtedly tell that someone is pulling the strings behind the scenes.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: But she will accept it, because she and Ashford have nothing to lose and everything to gain.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I learned this from the Doctor. Weave all the information together, into a web that the other side will jump in with both feet, even though they know full well it's exactly what we wanted them to do.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: This will do for the simulation, I think.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: It's as far as I can go, under present circumstances.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: As for the rest...

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Adnachiel!

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Oh, thank goodness. I was just about to die of fright.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Oh, spare me, Adnachiel. You look nothing like a prisoner in despair.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Remember that you're paying for a whole week's meals, Adnachiel!

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: You're asking for so much?

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Of course! Melantha signed off on it.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: You're not getting out of it this time, Adnachiel.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Hehe.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Oh, what happened to the pure and innocent Cardigan that I know?

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: The one whom you duped into paying your lunch all the time?

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: She's not so easy to fool now, thanks to a certain prophet.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Looks like everything's taken care of.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: The patients have settled down.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: The viscount has agreed to build a hospital on the undeveloped plate with Rhodes Island. We're working out the details.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Everything as you planned.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: ...Good to hear. Thanks for the hard work, guys.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Well, I got the easy part. All I needed to do was care for the patients.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: All I needed to do was sit here and wait for you guys to get things done.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: You know, Adnachiel, this humility of yours, there's a bit of the Doctor in it.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: ...I didn't realize how big the gulf was between me and the Doctor, until I actually tried to pull the strings in the same way.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: The challenge that we face and the burden that we carry are incomparable.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: But I'm glad I took that step.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Well, now that things have settled down, shall we go get something to eat?

steps.name: Lateran Messenger
steps.text: Mr. Adnachiel?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: That's me.

steps.name: Lateran Messenger
steps.text: I bring news from the Holy City.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: ...Very well.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: What's going on, Adnachiel?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Sorry, Cardigan, but it looks like it'll be some time before I can buy you your meals.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Captain, now that things have settled down, I would like to request temporary leave.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: You've finally made up your mind.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Yes, I have.

steps.name: Lateran Messenger
steps.text: I bring word from Cardinal Lemuen.

steps.name: Lateran Messenger
steps.text: The Seventh Tribunal has approved your request to return to Laterano. You are asked to first go to the outskirts of the Holy City, where someone will be there to meet you.

steps.name: Lateran Messenger
steps.text: I will lead the way.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Should I expect to see you with a gun the next time we meet?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: The gun is not important.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: As I've said before, the power of the prophet does not mean I was chosen, nor does it mean that there are any hopes placed upon me.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Sankta like me appear from time to time, whose minds work a little differently from the ordinary Sankta.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: We must agree to join the Curia and be bound by it in order to win the right to carry a gun.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I just renounced this right in order to leave Laterano and see what's out there.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: And it's not for this right that I'm going back.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: You remember why the reserve op teams exist, don't you?

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Of course. They're only open to operators who uphold Rhodes Island's mission and commit themselves to it.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Many people wonder why we accepted this position, but we understand that it's not fame that we're after.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: What we want to do is help the Infected and mitigate the impact of Oripathy on Terra.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: This was the choice I made when I joined Rhodes Island, a choice that I have never regretted.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I'm going back because I want to understand what's happening to Terra.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Then, I'll come back.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: I don't think I've ever seen you so serious in all the time I've known you.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Yeah, not quite used to it.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: It's kind of weird.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: I think it's cool.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: ...I'm already starting to regret saying all that.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Say, there are lots of new desserts in the Holy City, right? Don't forget to bring some back.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I'll be going, then.
Adnachiel waves goodbye to his friends and sets off for Laterano with the Messenger.
He does not turn back.
Nor is there the sweet sorrow of parting on the faces of Cardigan and the others.
For parting is only fleeting, and tighter are the ties that bind them together.
